subject: general
question: With how many states of India does Nepal share its boundaries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Nepal shares its boundaries with 5 states of India.
 
• The states are Sikkim, West Bengal, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.
 
• Nepal is a landlocked country located in South Asia.
 
• It shares international borders with India to the south, east, and west, and China to the north.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sikkim:**

 
 
• Sikkim is one of the northeastern states of India.
 
• It shares a border with Nepal to the west.
 
 
 
• **West Bengal:**
 
 
• West Bengal is an eastern state of India.
 
• It shares a small border with Nepal in the northern part of the state.
 
 
 
• **Bihar:**
 
 
• Bihar is a state in eastern India.
 
• It shares a long border with Nepal.
 
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh:**
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh is a northern state of India.
 
• It also shares a significant border with Nepal.
 
 
 
• **Uttarakhand:**
 
 
• Uttarakhand is a state in northern India.
 
• It shares its international border with Nepal to the east.
 
 
 
• **Landlocked Country:**
 
 
• A landlocked country is one that is entirely enclosed by land or whose coastlines lie on closed seas.
 
• Nepal is landlocked, bordered by China to the north and India to the south, east, and west.
 
 
 
• **Geopolitical Significance:**
 
 
• Nepal's strategic location between India and China makes it geopolitically significant.
 
• It has a rich cultural heritage and is known for its mountainous terrain, including Mount Everest.
